variables.name: ECID
variables.description: Adobe Experience Cloud ID auto-collected by AEP Web SDK. Primary visitor identity.

variables.name: Page URL
variables.description: Full page URL of the current hit. Baseline dimension for all pages (BRD 101).

variables.name: Business Unit
variables.description: Business unit / brand owner for the property. Baseline dimension on every hit.

variables.name: Environment
variables.description: Environment flag (production/staging) powering the Production Data Only segment.

variables.name: Tracking Code (s.campaign)
variables.description: Native campaign tracking code sourced from URL query parameter (BRD 101).

variables.name: Marketing Channel
variables.description: OOTB Marketing Channel processing-rule dimension. Processing rules required (not defined here).

variables.name: Campaign Source
variables.description: SAINT classification of s.campaign — traffic source.

variables.name: Campaign Medium
variables.description: SAINT classification of s.campaign — medium.

variables.name: Campaign Name
variables.description: SAINT classification of s.campaign — campaign name.

variables.name: Campaign Content
variables.description: SAINT classification of s.campaign — creative/content variant.

variables.name: Geo Location
variables.description: OOTB geo-segmentation dimensions derived by Adobe from IP. Raw GPS never stored (BRD 1802).

variables.name: Device Type
variables.description: OOTB device/mobile dimensions from user-agent — supports responsive/mobile-first reporting (BRD 103).

variables.name: New vs Return Visitor
variables.description: OOTB return-frequency dimension — supports returning-visitor contextual banner (BRD 704).

variables.name: Page Name
variables.description: Human-readable page name on every hit (BRD 101).

variables.name: Site Section
variables.description: Top-level site section for content grouping across all pages (BRD 101).

variables.name: Page Type
variables.description: Records the type of page being viewed, including distinguishing venue detail pages from venue listing pages. (BRD 104, 107, 108, 1812)

variables.name: Brand Compliance Flag
variables.description: Flags whether the page conforms to Heritage SG brand guidelines and carries the standard government disclaimer (BRD 106/109).

variables.name: Programme / Installation ID
variables.description: Unique AEMaaCS ID of the programme/installation in context (BRD 104).

variables.name: Programme / Installation Title
variables.description: Display title of the programme/installation (BRD 104).

variables.name: Venue Name
variables.description: Venue associated with the programme/installation listing (BRD 104/401).

variables.name: Programme Schedule
variables.description: Programme date/time window shown on listing detail (BRD 104).

variables.name: Unlocked Content Status
variables.description: Whether optional unlocked content is present/visible for a scanned-in visitor (BRD 602/605/1104).

variables.name: First Festival Year
variables.description: firstFestivalYear content-model field flagging debut programmes/installations (BRD 1104).

variables.name: Login / Registration Status
variables.description: Registered vs unregistered visitor. Registration is optional with full content access (BRD 201/203).

variables.name: Hashed Visitor ID
variables.description: [Hashed — PII] Registered visitor profile ID, SHA-256 hashed in JS before collection. Never expiration (BRD 204/604/304).

variables.name: Registration Trigger Moment
variables.description: Context/moment that triggered the registration prompt (first QR scan, itinerary adoption, etc.) — funnel reporting by trigger (BRD 603/506/1205).

variables.name: Consent Tier State
variables.description: Three-tier consent state (Tier 0 Functional / Tier 1 Festival Marketing / Tier 2 Year-Round NHB). Unbundled, unchecked by default (BRD 301/302).

variables.name: Consent Action
variables.description: Consent action recorded (grant/withdraw) for the consent log, effective immediately (BRD 303/304).

variables.name: Cookie Consent Category State
variables.description: Cookie consent category states (Strictly Necessary / Analytics & Performance / Personalisation & Targeting). No pre-ticked acceptance (BRD 1808/1809/1811).

variables.name: Student Cohort Flag
variables.description: Derived student cohort flag from geolocation cluster, visit timing and referral source. Not stored as permanent PII; refreshed annually (BRD 1806).

variables.name: QR Scan Installation ID
variables.description: Installation ID captured on a QR check-in scan. Venue check-in derived from QR only, not GPS (BRD 601/604/1803).

variables.name: Trail Name
variables.description: Selected curated self-guided trail name (BRD 501/502).

variables.name: Trail Progress / Check-in Step
variables.description: Trail progress tracked via QR check-ins — current step / completion ratio (BRD 502).

variables.name: Itinerary ID
variables.description: Custom itinerary identifier for created/shared/adopted itineraries incl. Community Picks (BRD 503/506/507).

variables.name: Itinerary Share Method
variables.description: Native device share channel used for itinerary sharing (no social OAuth) (BRD 505/705).

variables.name: Itinerary Optimisation Suggestion
variables.description: Type of dismissible inline optimisation suggestion surfaced for itinerary conflicts/inefficiencies (BRD 504).

variables.name: Klook CTA Destination
variables.description: Off-site Klook ticketing CTA destination clicked (exit link). No ticketing built on SNF site (BRD 105).

variables.name: Map Interaction Type
variables.description: Interaction type on the Bras Basah–Bugis MapBox map (pin tap, zoom, directions). Map by Adobe using MapBox (BRD 401/402).

variables.name: Location Permission State
variables.description: Location permission grant/deny state driving proximity sorting vs default listing. Geolocation client-side only (BRD 403/404/1802).

variables.name: Listing Sort Mode
variables.description: Active listing sort/auto-sort mode (proximity, current-night, last-chance post-9pm) (BRD 403/404/701).

variables.name: Personalisation Use Case
variables.description: Adobe Target personalisation use case in context (Your picks tonight, Trending with your circle, returning banner) (BRD 702/703/704/706).

variables.name: Personalisation Experience / Variant
variables.description: Adobe Target activity/experience variant served — supports lift & conversion reporting (BRD 706/1203).

variables.name: Session Loop Cluster Hash
variables.description: [Hashed] Session hash cluster key powering 'Trending with your circle' chip. Non-PII hashed cluster id (BRD 703).

variables.name: Brand Concierge Query Intent
variables.description: Classified visitor intent for a Brand Concierge query (programme discovery, trail rec, venue info, general) (BRD 1405/1406).

variables.name: Brand Concierge Outcome
variables.description: Outcome of a Brand Concierge interaction (answered, escalated, failed) for engagement/escalation reporting (BRD 1406).

variables.name: AI / Agent Crawler Source
variables.description: Identifies AI-powered / agentic crawler source for GEO & LLMO visibility reporting (BRD 901/902/1303).

variables.name: Social Share Surface
variables.description: Social sharing surface / Open Graph–Twitter Card context on programme detail and shareable itinerary pages (BRD 1001/1002).

variables.name: Content Author / Publish Source
variables.description: AEMaaCS publish source/channel (independent author publish vs migration) for content governance reporting (BRD 1102/1103).

variables.name: Newsletter Subscription Topic
variables.description: Captures the topic selected when a visitor submits a newsletter sign-up form. (BRD 1950)

variables.name: Page URL
variables.description: Mirrors the Page URL eVar to enable PathFinder pathing analysis across the SNF site. Captures the full page URL on every hit.

variables.name: Business Unit
variables.description: Mirrors the Business Unit eVar to enable ClickMap / PatternMatch segmentation of pathing by business unit. Constant value for the SNF site.

variables.name: Page Name
variables.description: Mirrors the Page Name eVar to enable PathFinder pathing across programme, installation and content pages. Supports requirement 104 (programme/installation listing display tracking).

variables.name: Site Section
variables.description: Mirrors the Site Section eVar to enable PatternMatch / ClickMap analysis of section-level navigation across the festival site.

variables.name: Programme Name
variables.description: Mirrors the Programme Name eVar to support content pathing analysis of which programmes/installations visitors traverse. Supports requirement 104.

variables.name: Venue Name
variables.description: Mirrors the Venue Name eVar to enable PathFinder analysis of venue-to-venue navigation on the precinct map and listings. Supports requirement 401 (interactive precinct map).

variables.name: Trail Name
variables.description: Mirrors the Trail Name eVar to enable pathing analysis of which curated self-guided trails visitors view and follow. Supports requirement 501 (trail presentation).

variables.name: Registration Flow Step
variables.description: Mirrors the Registration Journey Step eVar to enable PathFinder analysis of the email registration funnel flow. Supports requirement 201 (email registration verification).

variables.name: Installation ID
variables.description: Mirrors the Installation ID eVar to enable PatternMatch analysis of QR check-in sequences across installations. Supports requirement 604 (QR scan events / confirmed check-ins).

variables.name: Custom Page View
variables.description: Counts every page view fired on page load. Baseline page-view counter for all site pages.

variables.name: Page Load Time (ms)
variables.description: Numeric page load time in milliseconds. Pairs with Page Load Time Instances to derive Avg Page Load Time calculated metric. Supports BRD 1501-1504 performance monitoring.

variables.name: Page Load Time Instances
variables.description: Counter incremented once per page-load-time measurement. Denominator for Avg Page Load Time.

variables.name: Registration Start
variables.description: Fires when a visitor begins the email registration flow. Start event of the registration funnel. Supports BRD 201, 202, 1205.

variables.name: Email Verification Sent
variables.description: Fires when a one-time code or verification link is dispatched to the visitor's email. Supports BRD 201, 1603.

variables.name: Registration Complete (Email Verified)
variables.description: Fires when email registration is verified via one-time code or link. Complete event of the registration funnel. Supports BRD 201, 202, 1205.

variables.name: Registration Fail
variables.description: Fires when a registration attempt fails (invalid email, expired code, abandoned verification). Fail event of the registration funnel. Supports BRD 201, 202, 1205.

variables.name: Consent Granted
variables.description: Fires when a visitor grants a consent tier (Tier 0 Functional, Tier 1 Festival Marketing, Tier 2 Year-Round NHB). Consent tier captured alongside in context data. Supports BRD 301, 302, 304, 1204.

variables.name: Consent Withdrawn
variables.description: Fires when a visitor withdraws consent via self-service profile settings, effective immediately. Supports BRD 303, 304.

variables.name: Cookie Consent Submitted
variables.description: Fires when a visitor submits a cookie consent choice from the banner or settings control. Cookie category selections captured in context data. Supports BRD 1808, 1809, 1810, 1811.

variables.name: Programme/Installation Listing View
variables.description: Fires when a festival programme or installation listing is displayed (title, description, venue, dates, times). Supports BRD 104.

variables.name: Klook Ticketing CTA Click
variables.description: Fires when a visitor clicks the Klook ticketing call-to-action directing off-site. Exit-link style interaction. Supports BRD 105.

variables.name: Unlocked Content View
variables.description: Fires when unlocked content visible only to physically scanned-in visitors is displayed on a programme detail page. Supports BRD 602, 605.

variables.name: Map Interaction
variables.description: Fires on interaction with the interactive Bras Basah–Bugis precinct map (pin tap, pan, zoom). Supports BRD 401, 402, 1201.

variables.name: Location Permission Granted
variables.description: Fires when a visitor grants location permission enabling proximity-based sorting by walking distance. Geolocation processed client-side only. Supports BRD 403, 1802.

variables.name: Location Permission Denied
variables.description: Fires when a visitor denies location permission; listings fall back to default behaviour without degradation. Supports BRD 404.

variables.name: Trail View
variables.description: Fires when a curated self-guided trail is presented for selection and navigation. Supports BRD 501.

variables.name: Trail Saved
variables.description: Fires when a registered visitor saves/follows a trail. Supports BRD 502.

variables.name: Itinerary Created
variables.description: Fires when a visitor creates a custom itinerary by adding chosen programmes/installations. Supports BRD 503.

variables.name: Itinerary Optimisation Suggestion Shown
variables.description: Fires when a dismissible, non-blocking inline optimisation suggestion is surfaced for itinerary conflicts/inefficiencies. Supports BRD 504.

variables.name: Itinerary Shared
variables.description: Fires when a visitor shares an itinerary via native device share. Supports BRD 505, 705.

variables.name: Shared Itinerary Adopted
variables.description: Fires on one-tap adoption of a shared itinerary (login-free viewing), triggering a light registration prompt. Supports BRD 506, 507, 705.

variables.name: Community Pick Surfaced
variables.description: Fires when an itinerary reaching ≥10 unique festival-window adoptions is surfaced as a Community Pick on the Trails page. Supports BRD 507, 705.

variables.name: QR Scan Check-in
variables.description: Fires on a QR scan recorded as a confirmed check-in against the registered visitor's profile, capturing installation ID and timestamp. Venue check-in derived exclusively from QR, not GPS. Supports BRD 601, 604, 1803.

variables.name: QR Registration Prompt Shown
variables.description: Fires when a dismissible email registration prompt is triggered on the first QR scan by an unauthenticated visitor. Supports BRD 603, 1205.

variables.name: Programme Bookmarked
variables.description: Fires when a registered visitor bookmarks a programme, feeding the 'Your picks tonight' affinity feed. Supports BRD 702, 703.

variables.name: Personalisation Content Served
variables.description: Fires when an Adobe Target personalisation experience is served (picks feed, trending chip, returning-visitor banner, auto-sorted listing). Use case captured in context data. Supports BRD 701, 702, 703, 704, 706, 1203.

variables.name: Brand Concierge Interaction
variables.description: Fires on a Brand Concierge query/interaction. Query intent captured in context data for engagement and intent reporting. Supports BRD 1404, 1405, 1406.

variables.name: Brand Concierge Escalation/Failure
variables.description: Fires when a Brand Concierge interaction escalates or fails to resolve. Powers escalation/failure rate reporting. Supports BRD 1406.

variables.name: Data Rights Request Submitted
variables.description: Fires when a visitor submits a self-service view, correction or erasure request cascading to visit history and AEP event data. Request type captured in context data. Supports BRD 1805, 1807.

variables.name: Newsletter Sign-Up
variables.description: Fires on successful newsletter sign-up form submission. (BRD 1950)

segments.name: Bounce Rate
segments.description: Percentage of single-hit visits. Standard engagement health metric.

segments.name: Conversion Rate
segments.description: Ratio of key conversion events (e.g. registration, QR check-in) to visits.

segments.name: Pages per Visit
segments.description: Average number of page views per visit. Standard depth-of-engagement metric.

segments.name: All Visits
segments.description: Total visit count across the report suite.

segments.name: New Visitors
segments.description: Count of visitors whose first visit falls within the reporting window.

segments.name: Returning Visitors
segments.description: Count of visitors with prior visit history in the reporting window.

segments.name: Authenticated Users
segments.description: Count of visits where Login/Registration status indicates an authenticated (registered) visitor.

segments.name: Production Data Only
segments.description: Isolates production traffic where the Environment eVar equals 'production'. Default segment applied to all project reporting to exclude dev/stage beacons.

segments.name: Registered Visitors
segments.description: Visitor-scoped segment where registration/login status indicates email-verified registered visitors (BRD 201/202). Used for registered-only features and funnel reporting.

segments.name: Unregistered Visitors
segments.description: Visitor-scoped segment where registration status is anonymous/guest (BRD 203). Confirms unregistered visitors retain full content access.

segments.name: Derived Student Cohort
segments.description: Visitor-scoped segment on the derived student cohort flag (geolocation cluster + visit timing + referral source, BRD 1806). Not permanent PII; refreshed annually.

segments.name: Consent Tier 0 — Functional
segments.description: Visitor-scoped segment on consent tier capture at registration (BRD 301). Visitors who granted Tier 0 Functional consent.

segments.name: Consent Tier 1 — Festival Marketing
segments.description: Visitor-scoped segment on Tier 1 Festival Marketing consent (BRD 301/302, unbundled positive action). Supports consent tier distribution reporting (BRD 1204).

segments.name: Consent Tier 2 — Year-Round NHB
segments.description: Visitor-scoped segment on Tier 2 Year-Round NHB consent (BRD 301/302). Supports consent tier distribution reporting (BRD 1204).

segments.name: Consent Withdrawn
segments.description: Visitor-scoped segment capturing visitors who withdrew consent via self-service settings (BRD 303), effective immediately.

segments.name: QR Checked-in Visits
segments.description: Visit-scoped segment where at least one QR check-in event fired against the registered visitor profile (BRD 604).

segments.name: Unlocked Content Viewers
segments.description: Visit-scoped segment of physically scanned-in visitors who viewed QR-unlocked programme content (BRD 602/605).

segments.name: Klook Ticketing CTA Clickers
segments.description: Visit-scoped segment of visits clicking the off-site Klook ticketing call-to-action (BRD 105).

segments.name: Map Interaction Visits
segments.description: Visit-scoped segment of visits interacting with the Bras Basah–Bugis precinct map (BRD 401).

segments.name: Location Permission Granted
segments.description: Visit-scoped segment where visitor granted location permission enabling proximity-based sorting (BRD 403).

segments.name: Trail Savers / Followers
segments.description: Visitor-scoped segment of registered visitors who saved and followed a self-guided trail with QR progress (BRD 502).

segments.name: Custom Itinerary Creators
segments.description: Visitor-scoped segment of visitors who created a custom itinerary by adding programmes/installations (BRD 503).

segments.name: Itinerary Sharers
segments.description: Visit-scoped segment of visits sharing an itinerary via native device share (BRD 505).

segments.name: Shared Itinerary Adopters
segments.description: Visit-scoped segment of visits performing one-tap adoption of a shared itinerary (BRD 506/507), feeding Community Picks surfacing.

segments.name: Personalisation-Exposed Visitors
segments.description: Visitor-scoped segment of visitors exposed to Adobe Target personalisation use cases (BRD 701–706).

segments.name: Brand Concierge Engaged Visits
segments.description: Visit-scoped segment of visits engaging the Adobe Brand Concierge conversational assistant (BRD 1404–1406).

segments.name: Brand Concierge Escalation / Failure
segments.description: Visit-scoped segment of Brand Concierge sessions that escalated or failed to resolve the intent (BRD 1406).

segments.name: Mobile Viewport Visits
segments.description: Visit-scoped segment of visits on mobile viewports (OOTB device/viewport dimension) per responsive, mobile-first delivery (BRD 103).

Implement Twitter Card meta tags on programme detail and shareable itinerary pages.
Manage all website content via AEMaaCS delivered using Edge Delivery Services for peak-traffic performance.
Enable Heritage SG authors to update and publish content independently without developer involvement.
Deliver a one-time bulk, high-speed content migration from existing Heritage SG content.
Include optional unlockedContent and firstFestivalYear fields in the AEMaaCS programme/installation content model.
Configure Adobe Analytics workspaces and dashboards covering real-time activity, engagement, QR rates, registration funnel and map interaction.
Provide a real-time operational dashboard throughout the festival window for active sessions, venue engagement and registration activity.
Configure Adobe Target activity reporting surfacing lift, confidence and conversion rates per active use case.
Provide AEP profile and segment reporting on registered visitor counts, consent tier distribution and key RT-CDP segment sizes.
Report registration and consent funnel performance by registration trigger moment.
Produce a comprehensive post-festival analytics report against all KPIs, use case outcomes and secondary KPIs.

Use LLMO as an active optimisation layer complementing the GEO requirements.
Align LLMO configuration with Heritage SG brand guidelines for on-brand, accurate AI representations.

Make Brand Concierge available to all visitors regardless of registration status.
Support Brand Concierge visitor intents including programme discovery, trail recommendations, venue info and general festival information.
Instrument Brand Concierge interactions via Adobe Analytics for engagement rates, query intents and escalation/failure rates.
Conduct performance testing approximately 2 weeks prior to the website launch date.
Sustain peak festival traffic loads with specific load targets defined during solution design.
Define and agree target page load times with Heritage SG during solution design.

Remediate all critical and high-severity vulnerabilities before go-live.
Use email-only visitor authentication with no SMS of any kind.

requirements.requirement: Conform the website to WCAG 2.1 Level AA.
Validate accessibility compliance as part of QA prior to launch.
Comply with Singapore's PDPA and the Do Not Call (DNC) Registry Act for the website and all data collection.
Process geolocation client-side only, passing a derived zone label to Adobe Target and never storing raw GPS server-side.
Derive venue check-in data exclusively from QR scan events (installation ID), not GPS.
Retain visitor personal data for a maximum of 36 months or until consent withdrawal, whichever is earlier.
Provide self-service view, correction and erasure of personal data cascading to visit history and AEP event data.
Derive the student cohort flag from geolocation cluster, visit timing and referral source without storing it as permanent PII, refreshed annually.
Comply with PDPA obligations for Singapore Government websites, PDPC advisory guidelines and statutory board data policies, confirmed with NHB DPO pre-go-live.
Implement a PDPA-compliant cookie consent mechanism categorising cookies as Strictly Necessary, Analytics & Performance, and Personalisation & Targeting.
Display a cookie consent banner on first visit and suppress non-essential cookies until explicit consent, with no pre-ticked acceptance.
Provide an accessible cookie settings control to manage preferences at any time, with withdrawal effective immediately.
Record cookie consent choices per visitor and respect them across sessions without relying on a non-essential cookie.
Provide an accessible Cookie Policy page documenting all cookies, purpose, category and retention period.
